{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-opus-5-5","id":"msg_011CgDHrWeaGSjXjFBEmHCRB","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_0173REcrvz8WhW8vGnQjp9kn","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/app/answer.py","content":"import numpy as np\nimport pandas as pd\nfrom scipy.stats import chi2\n\nDATA_PATH = \"/app/dataset/synthetic_stroke_data.csv\"\nNUM_COLS = [\"age\", \"bmi\", \"avg_glucose_level\"]\n\n\ndef iqr_mask(s: pd.Series, k: float = 3.0) -> pd.Series:\n    q1, q3 = s.quantile([0.25, 0.75])\n    iqr = q3 - q1\n    return (s < q1 - k * iqr) | (s > q3 + k * iqr)\n\n\ndef answer() -> list[int]:\n    df = pd.read_csv(DATA_PATH)\n    df[\"row_idx\"] = np.arange(len(df))  # first row indexed as 0\n    id_to_idx = dict(zip(df[\"patient_id\"], df[\"row_idx\"]))\n\n    # 1. Technical noise: values that cannot occur in reality\n    noise = (\n        (df[\"avg_glucose_level\"] < 20) | (df[\"avg_glucose_level\"] > 800)\n        | (df[\"bmi\"] < 10) | (df[\"bmi\"] > 60)\n        | (df[\"age\"] < 0) | (df[\"age\"] > 120)\n    )\n    noise_ids = df.loc[noise, \"patient_id\"].tolist()\n    clean = df.loc[~noise].copy()\n\n    # 2. Extreme outliers with 3*IQR\n    iqr_ids = []\n    for col in [\"age\", \"bmi\"]:\n        iqr_ids += clean.loc[iqr_mask(clean[col]), \"patient_id\"].tolist()\n\n    # avg_glucose_level: check association with stroke before rejecting\n    glu = clean[\"avg_glucose_level\"]\n    m = iqr_mask(glu)\n    for _ in range(2):\n        if not m.any():\n            break\n        stroke_rate = clean.loc[m, \"stroke\"].mean()\n        if stroke_rate >= 0.5:\n            m[:] = False\n            break\n        if stroke_rate > 0.2:\n            glu = np.log2(glu)\n            m = iqr_mask(glu)\n            continue\n        break\n    iqr_ids += clean.loc[m, \"patient_id\"].tolist()\n\n    clean = clean[~clean[\"patient_id\"].isin(iqr_ids)].copy()\n\n    # 3. Risk proxy: product of max-normalized numerical features\n    clean[\"risk_proxy\"] = np.prod(\n        [clean[c] / clean[c].max() for c in NUM_COLS], axis=0\n    )\n\n    # 4. Mahalanobis distance in the space of numerical variables\n    cols = NUM_COLS + [\"risk_proxy\"]\n    X = clean[cols].to_numpy()\n    diff = X - X.mean(axis=0)\n    inv_cov = np.linalg.inv(np.cov(X, rowvar=False))\n    d2 = np.einsum(\"ij,jk,ik->i\", diff, inv_cov, diff)\n    crit = chi2.ppf(1 - 0.01, df=len(cols))\n    maha_ids = clean.loc[d2 > crit, \"patient_id\"].tolist()\n\n    # 5. Implausible categorical values\n    children = df[\"age\"] <= 14\n    toddlers = df[\"age\"] <= 3\n    cat_mask = (\n        (children & df[\"smoking_status\"].isin([\"smokes\", \"formerly smoked\"]))\n        | (children & df[\"work_type\"].isin([\"Private\", \"Self-employed\", \"Govt_job\"]))\n        | ((df[\"age\"] > 14) & (df[\"work_type\"] == \"children\"))\n        | (toddlers & (df[\"work_type\"] == \"student\"))\n    )\n    cat_ids = df.loc[cat_mask, \"patient_id\"].tolist()\n\n    all_ids = set(noise_ids) | set(iqr_ids) | set(maha_ids) | set(cat_ids)\n    return sorted(int(id_to_idx[pid]) for pid in all_ids)\n\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    import json\n    with open(\"/app/answer.json\", \"w\") as f:\n        json.dump(answer(), f, default=list)\n"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"container":null,"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":751,"cache_read_input_tokens":33546,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":751,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0},"output_tokens":3,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"global","speed":"standard"},"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"51d83ffc-70fa-46d4-995e-e6be52b11709","uuid":"8bf86c47-b19a-4562-aafa-84f14a432e15","timestamp":"2026-10-20T09:58:46.676Z"}
